note: Learned layer over foundation's HI-Graph. foundation is the literature prior and is never edited; everything here was produced by measurement inside the loop.

subject: Case Assignment
Numerical Involvement
contradictions.prior_said: The pair is HARD_CONFLICT and cannot be applied together when they share an affected activity.
contradictions.measured_said: Both candidates shared A_CANCELLED, the condition fired, and Phase-3 successfully built the combined redesign.
evidence: get_pair_relation returned HARD_CONFLICT with condition_fires=true and shared activity A_CANCELLED
Phase-3 outcome: CA-002 and NI-001 both applied successfully
contradictions.note: The pair can form a legal model, although their effects may remain difficult to attribute and can produce contention.

subject: Case Assignment
contradictions.prior_said: Case Assignment has a weak positive impact on time.
contradictions.measured_said: CA-002 produced worse sole-owned throughput and sharply increased waiting under the merged pool.
evidence: CA-002 sole-owned throughput worsened by 1.059 h per case, z=36.31
A_DECLINED waiting rose with z=42.61 while duration remained flat
CA-002 was applied successfully in Phase-3
contradictions.note: This is strong candidate-level counterevidence but not sufficient to overturn the general heuristic because other case-assignment effects were shared or favorable; retain the prior with a contention caveat.

subject: Numerical Involvement
contradictions.prior_said: Numerical Involvement has a strong positive impact on time by reducing coordination and handover waiting.
contradictions.measured_said: NI-001 increased queueing on affected activities, including O_CANCELLED, while service duration stayed flat.
evidence: O_CANCELLED waiting rose with z=7.41 under NI-001
A_CANCELLED waiting also rose in the CA-002/NI-001 shared change with z=3.50
NI-001 was applied successfully in Phase-3
contradictions.note: The adverse queueing signal is real but attribution is partly shared, so record the need for a pool-capacity caveat rather than revising the general impact yet.

subject: Activity Elimination
contradictions.prior_said: Removing a non-value-adding step strongly improves time and cost.
contradictions.measured_said: AE-002's eliminated activity produced a large sole-attributed throughput improvement.
evidence: W_Nabellen offertes removal reduced time by 2.778 h per case, z=-96.24
Whole-plan median throughput improved by 34.56%, z=-17.66
contradictions.note: The elimination prior is supported; no correction is needed.

subject: Specialize
contradictions.prior_said: Specialization improves time, while queueing consequences must be measured rather than assumed.
contradictions.measured_said: The specialization candidates produced measured throughput improvement or shared service-time improvement, with no demonstrated refutation of the time direction.
evidence: SPC-003 reduced sole-owned activity time by 5.7268 h per case, z=-38.72
SPC-002's detector measured a 3.16x specialist service-speed difference, separation z=5.57
SPC-002 and SPC-001 were applied successfully in Phase-3
contradictions.note: The measured results support the positive service-time direction while confirming that shared attribution and queue effects must remain empirical.
